project.title: Killer Influence
project.tagline: Elevated survival-horror for the algorithm age
dna: Meta-viral engine tied to engagement metrics
project.visual_language: Dual: 9:16 content frames vs. widescreen surveillance dread

neon_noir.description: Red/blue mixed light, smoky air, high contrast glow

clinical_decay.description: Sickly greens, fluorescent buzz, sterile grime

surveillance_cold.description: White overhead rig light, hard shadow edges

scenes.name: The Red Corridor
scenes.subtitle: Entrance / Execution Zone

narrative_context.description: Initial entrapment. Studio doors seal. Nine influencers realize the game is real when the first 'accident' occurs.
narrative_context.key_moment: The Voice's first decree, threshold between invitation and imprisonment

scenes.prompt: cinematic wide shot inside red-lit corridor labeled "S1," two hooded silhouettes framed by glowing crimson light, fog swirling around their feet, glossy black floor reflections, flickering overhead fluorescents, deep shadows hide faces, 35 mm lens, handheld ARRI Alexa Mini LF, aperture f/2.8 shallow DOF, moody neon noir lighting, algorithmic horror aesthetic, film grain 8K realism
scenes.thematic_notes: Algorithmic horror aesthetic. Entry point to the game. Red = danger, recording, bloodshed.

scenes.name: The Asylum Wing
scenes.subtitle: Medical Set

narrative_context.description: Soundstage reconfigures into decaying hospital. First mandatory 'scene' production. Virality demands they cut real tragedy into the edit.
narrative_context.key_moment: LEXI's practical effects become weaponized. Film gear turns lethal.

scenes.prompt: decaying hospital corridor from the late 20th century, sickly green and beige palette, cracked tiles, IV stands casting long silhouettes, flickering fluorescent lights, reflective linoleum, faint blood smears near drainage grate, shallow depth of field, Sony FX6 cinema camera, 35 mm prime lens, cinema handheld shot, sterile but grimy mood
scenes.thematic_notes: Medical set as trap. IV stands = spears. Surgical tools = weapons. Institutional horror meets practical SFX.

scenes.name: The Detention Block
scenes.subtitle: School Hallway

narrative_context.description: School hallway configuration targets nostalgia and innocence. Metrics = morality. Refusal triggers punishment. Trust collapses.
narrative_context.key_moment: REBECCA tries to maintain order; the rulebook burns. Forced participation.

scenes.prompt: abandoned 1990s school hallway, lockers with faded graffiti, one silhouette slamming door, flickering light creates motion blur, dust in air, handheld look with film grain, Canon C300 Mark III 50 mm lens, aperture f/2, nostalgic but menacing tone, neon yellow and muted green light palette
scenes.thematic_notes: Analog grain = found-footage authenticity. 90s nostalgia weaponized. Childhood spaces as death traps.

scenes.name: The Guts
scenes.subtitle: Boiler Room

narrative_context.description: Set reconfigures against them. Pipes burst, steam scalds. Infrastructure exposed. Alliances tested. Gear becomes murder weapons.
narrative_context.key_moment: BRAD's stunt skills fail—safety rigs can't save you when environment is sentient.

scenes.prompt: industrial boiler room labyrinth of pipes and valves, red warning lights cutting through dense steam, faceless silhouettes outlined by glow, wet metal and condensation dripping, tungsten backlight with smoke depth, Blackmagic URSA Mini Pro G2, 24 mm lens low angle, cinematic texture 8K clarity
scenes.thematic_notes: 'The Guts' = exposed machinery of the game. SAW-style mechanical horror. Claustrophobic spatial dread.

scenes.name: The Panopticon
scenes.subtitle: TV Studio / Control Room

narrative_context.description: Dual-reality nerve center. Half backstage infrastructure, half glittering broadcast studio. Where performance meets punishment.
narrative_context.key_moment: Meta-commentary space. Red tally lights = death sentences. Audience complicity reveal.

scenes.prompt: dual reality environment, half raw concrete backstage corridor, half glittering LED TV studio, faceless host silhouette center frame under glitching spotlight, red and blue light split the scene, confetti drifting in slow motion, overhead rigging visible, ARRI Alexa LF 65 mm lens, steady-cam tracking, high-contrast lighting mix
scenes.thematic_notes: MOST IMPORTANT thematic space. Confetti = celebration of death. LED = algorithm made physical. THE TRUMAN SHOW horror.

scenes.name: The Open Room
scenes.subtitle: Central Arena

narrative_context.story_beat: THE REVELATION - All Sets Were One
narrative_context.description: Overhead reveal: entire soundstage exposed. All 'sets' (S1-S9) visible as modular zones. Survivors realize they've been rats in a maze.
narrative_context.key_moment: Spatial revelation. God's-eye-view of the game. Pre-finale positioning.

scenes.prompt: overhead drone shot of massive soundstage arena, walls labeled S1-S9, red tally lights glowing on rigging, seven silhouetted figures standing in a circle on polished concrete, fog layers and diffused white light from above, Epic 8K aerial composition with high contrast, digital grain realism
scenes.thematic_notes: SQUID GAME reference. Arena reveal. All horror spaces exist simultaneously. Audience watching from above.

scenes.name: The Open Space
scenes.subtitle: Exit Illusion / End Scene

narrative_context.description: Tunnel to freedom. Red lights fade to white. But white light = stage lights. LEXI emerges into LIVE STUDIO AUDIENCE. She was content all along.
narrative_context.key_moment: False exit. THE BELKO EXPERIMENT ending. Twist: survival = ratings. Viewers were complicit.

scenes.prompt: dark tunnel leading from soundstage, red emergency lights fade into white doorway in distance, silhouettes walking toward light, fog dense near floor, cables overhead form abstract geometry, Sony Venice 50 mm lens, f/1.8 depth, cinematic long exposure glow, psychological thriller tone
scenes.thematic_notes: White light = audience. Meta-reveal. LEXI isn't escaping, she's debuting. Ultimate horror: viewers complicit all along.

vertical_content_9_16.use_for: Social media POVs, character reaction shots, 'viral content' being filmed within story

steps.action: Generate stills in Midjourney V7 using scene prompts
Select hero frames for each scene
Edit in DaVinci Resolve or Premiere
post_production: Sound design (PA announcements, tally light beeps, THE VOICE)
Color grade per lighting mood codes
